title: Edit algebra has no batch create: every transform recipe loops edits.createFile over its creates
wanted_capability: One edits call that queues several {path, content} creates (or folds a transform result's changes and creates together), with the same collision checks as edits.createFile, so transform recipes stop repeating a per-file createFile loop.
fallback_used: Looped over `creates` and called `edits.createFile` once per file.
evidence: crates/bro-harness/src/bindings/java_transforms.rs (transform recipes: for (const c of r.creates) await edits.createFile(...))
notes: This probe only created one file, so it was not painful here; the resumed probe flagged it as a scaling issue for sweeps.
resolution_note: Addressed by https://github.com/daystrom-institute/blackbox/issues/36 via PR #94, delivered in commit 7608d2bc. edits.createFiles queues a batch atomically with collision checks and bounded inputs. Regression coverage includes whole-batch refusal and concurrent overlapping batches.
